not_covered: Formal GWG 2022/2024 sheetfed or packaging conformance certificates
PDF/X-5, PDF/VT, and PDF/A-3 conversion claims
DeviceN ink-limit per named colorant beyond inventory
priority_rule: P1 - no registered check inspects the defect class at all (a matrix not_covered entry), so a clean run is silent about it; P2 - a registered check inspects the class but its named limitation can suppress or misclassify a finding on defective content, which would be a false clean pass; P3 - a registered check inspects the class and the named limitation only narrows reported detail or fails closed as incomplete, so it cannot turn a defect into a silent pass.

rows.gap: Barcode / slug / Braille content validation
DeviceN ink-limit per named colorant beyond inventory
Formal GWG 2022/2024 sheetfed or packaging conformance certificates
Multi-page imposition and reader-spread checks
PDF/X-5, PDF/VT, and PDF/A-3 conversion claims: PDF/VT variable-data streams are neither understood, validated, nor preserved
PDF/X-5, PDF/VT, and PDF/A-3 conversion claims: PDF/X-5 (X-5n/X-5g) and PDF/A-3 output are neither validated nor produced
content-bleed raster confirmation is opt-in and the strip probe reads at probe_dpi, so sparse marks below probe_threshold can pass while the bleed margin is empty

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture whose ICC space resolves to an allowed alternate, so the false pass is reproducible rather than argued.
rows.gap: an ICC-based color space is classified by its alternate, so a page whose ICC space resolves to an allowed alternate can pass while the painted space is disallowed
embedded font programs that fail to parse, or lose their cmap, were unchecked; font-integrity now reports them (filed as #130)
a DeviceN dieline is described by a multi-colorant separation, so the Separation-only processing-step collector can miss the die entirely and the packaging job passes clean
processing-steps and dieline detect cutting-die presence but not die geometry, so a geometrically wrong dieline passes clean

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture with a parsable embedded program that is missing a used glyph.
rows.gap: font-integrity parses the embedded program and its cmap but is not a glyph-coverage audit, so a missing glyph that still parses passes clean
stroke widths below a job threshold, including zero-width hairlines, were unchecked; thin-strokes now measures them

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture with an optional-content membership configuration that hides print content.
rows.gap: the shared hidden-content scan does not enumerate every optional-content membership-dictionary combination, so an unprintable configuration passes clean

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture with an isolated over-limit element below min_region_area_pct.
rows.gap: ink-coverage is a raster probe that suppresses regions below min_region_area_pct, so an isolated over-limit element passes clean

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture painting an invisible class outside text render mode 3 and zero-alpha graphics state.
rows.gap: invisible-content covers text render mode 3 and zero-alpha graphics state only, so other invisible classes pass clean (the wider detector is filed as #124)
fonts used only inside nested Form XObjects, inherited resources, or annotation appearance streams were unchecked; embedded-fonts now traverses them (filed as #70)

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture where a bounding-box heuristic cannot see the occlusion a RIP would.
rows.gap: obscured-content is a bounding-box heuristic rather than a RIP occlusion model, so covered content can pass clean

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture whose clipped mark exposes the pre-clip bounds comparison.
rows.gap: off-page-content compares painted bounds before clipping, so a clipped mark can be a false negative or a false positive
output intent presence, identity, subtype, and ICC payload were unchecked; output-intent now validates them (filed as #12)
thin filled parts, not only strokes, were unchecked for a minimum width; thin-parts now measures them (filed as #131)

rows.deferral: Deferred: filing needs a fixture reproducing an overprint-plus-transparency interaction only a RIP flattens.
rows.gap: transparency-risk does not flatten and does not simulate overprint-plus-transparency interaction as a RIP does, so a press-only interaction passes clean
white-overprint reads page-view overprint state rather than the Output Preview or transparency renderer, so a renderer-dependent white overprint passes clean
the bleed check measures and rewrites page boxes only and synthesizes no artwork bleed; artwork bleed itself is measured by content-bleed

rows.deferral: Register-only: P3, the limitation narrows inventoried detail rather than turning a defect into a silent pass.
rows.gap: color-inventory is bounded by probe_dpi and is a spot, separation, and rich-black inventory rather than a named-ink dictionary, so small tints are inventoried incompletely

rows.deferral: Register-only: P3, the shortfall fails closed as an incomplete inspection rather than passing silently.
rows.gap: thin-parts reports a page as check-incomplete when the mask exceeds max_raster_pixels instead of passing it, so the shortfall is an incomplete inspection rather than a silent pass

state_rule: open - the gap is still present; landed - a registered check now covers the class and closed_by names that check id; closed - the filed issue that tracked the gap is closed.
